title: Psytrance Mix Review
level_1_guidance: Check that kick, bass, drums, synths, FX, reference, and sidechain-control tracks are clearly named or routed.
Treat HPF, compression, and EQ-overlap findings as low-confidence heuristics unless stronger evidence exists.
Reference tracks and sidechain triggers should not feed the export path.
level_2_guidance: Capture the main drop or loudest chorus for 8 to 60 seconds.
Use live/watch peaks for headroom, clipping risk, and hot-track fraction only.
notes: This profile is guidance only. It must not create confirmed genre findings without matching evidence.
Actual rendered-master and stem analysis is pending external analyzer integration for Mix Review Level 3/4.
limitations: Static profile guidance is heuristic; no static psytrance finding is treated as audio-confirmed.
Kick/bass masking, phase, loudness, and stereo conclusions require Level 3/4 evidence.
